s: Business English News 63 Elon Musk and SpaceX
商业英语新闻 63 伊隆·马斯克和SpaceX
Open the news on any given day, and you're sure to see a picture of one of Big Tech's Broligarchy.
在任何一天打开新闻，而你肯定会看到大科技公司的一张照片。
These days, you can bet OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropix Dario Amade feel some relief that everyone's focused on disgraced NVIDIA CEO Jensen Wong.
今天，你可以打，OpenAI的萨姆·阿尔特曼和安特罗皮克斯的达里奥·阿玛德感到有所缓解，
One press-loving tech Titan who has surprisingly kept a low profile recently is Elon Musk.
一位热爱媒体的科技巨头，最近令人惊地保持低调，是伊隆·马斯克。
This comes despite the fact that earlier this year Musk achieved trillionaire status.
尽管今年早些时候马斯克获得了亿万富翁的地位。
The durability of that distinction, however, is in question according to Forbes.
据"福布斯"报道，这一区别的持久性却受到质疑。
That status has proved fragile.
这种地位是脆弱的。
Musk has since called himself a former trillionaire, and his fortune has hovered around the line.
马斯克自称是前亿万富翁，而他的财富都在边界。
Forbes determined he regained trillionaire status on October 9th, then pegged his net worth at $977.2 billion on October 13th after SpaceX shares slid.
福布斯表示，他在10月9日恢复了亿万富翁地位，然后在10月13日，他的净值达到977.2亿美元。
Much of that wealth is also tied up in stock he can't sell for a year under the IPO lock-up.
很多财富都被绑在股票上，他不能在一年内出售。
How could one man amass a net worth beyond the annual GDP of all but 19 countries?
只有19个国家的年产总值才能超出一个人的净资产。
Well, Musk's first commercial success came at just 12 years old when he sold the source code for a video game to a computer magazine.
马斯克的首次商业成功是12岁时，当他向一个计算机杂志出售电子游戏的源代码时。
His first major business venture was Zip2, the sale of which netted Musk $22 million.
他的第一大商业企业是Zip2，销售额为马斯克2200万美元。
And that was the seed for all that came next, as explained by Yahoo Finance.
这就是接下来一切的种子，正如雅虎金融所解释的那样。
He used that money to launch X.com, an online banking startup founded in 1999.
他用这些钱发起了X.com，一家在线银行创业公司，成立于1999年。
The company later became part of PayPal, which was acquired by eBay in 2002 for 1.5 $5 billion.
该公司后来成为PayPal的一部分，该公司于2002年以1550亿美元的价格被eBay收购。
The sale provided the capital for the ventures that would define the next phase of his career.
销售为他职业生涯的下一个阶段决定的企业提供了资本。
In 2002, Musk founded SpaceX, investing roughly $100 million of his own money.
2002年，马斯克创立了SpaceX，他自己投资了大约1亿美元的钱。
And in 2004, he joined a new electric car company, Tesla, and invested approximately $80 million in the company.
2004年，他加入了一家新的电动汽车公司，他投资了8000万美元。
Musk helped transform Tesla into the world's biggest electric car maker.
马斯克帮助特斯拉成为世界上最大的电动汽车制造商。
maker. Along the way, he's placed bets on a wide variety of ventures.
在路上，他投注了各种各样的企业。
This includes Twitter, Neuralink, and the boring company, among many others.
这包括Twitter,Neuralink和无聊的公司，
Is this evidence of a scattered focus or strategic hedging?
这是分散的重点或战略性对冲的证据吗？
Regardless, it's important to point out that the strategy has depended in part on politics.
无论如何，重要的是要指出，这项战略部分取决于政治。
In particular, Musk's relationship with Donald Trump, as reported by the LA Times.
马斯克与唐纳德特朗普的关系。

I think the overall goals of Donald Trump and Elon Musk with doge are to slash regulations, to slash budgets and to cut positions all with this claim they are going to increase efficiency and fight fraud, said Lisa Gilbert, co-president of Public Citizen.
我认为唐纳德·特朗普和伊隆·马斯克的总体目标是削减监管，削减预算和削减所有职位，"公众公民"联合主席丽莎·吉尔伯特说。
The group calculated the administration halted or moved to dismiss investigations against against 89 corporations, including Musk's companies across multiple federal agencies.
该组织计算，政府暂停或撤销对89家公司的调查，包括马斯克公司在多个联邦机构中。
While Musk's image has been strongly entangled with Tesla, it's one of his other companies that's central to his future.
尽管马斯克的形象与特斯拉密切相关，但他的另一个公司是他未来的核心。
Rowing political influence and declining oversight have helped SpaceX most of all.
越来越多的政治影响力和监督下降，
Indeed, the company enjoys billions of dollars of government contracts, especially with NASA, NASA, and over 80% of new hardware launched into orbit is adorned with the SpaceX logo.
实际上，该公司拥有数十亿美元的政府合同，特别是在美国宇航局，超过80%的新发射到轨道上的硬件都装饰着SpaceX的标志。
It now appears that Musk wishes to consolidate other parts of his empire under this one company, as Reuters reports.
据路透社报道，马斯克现在希望在这个公司下巩固他的帝国的其他部分。

SpaceX has acquired his artificial intelligence startup XAI in a record-setting deal that unifies Musk's AI and space ambitions by combining the rocket and satellite company with the maker of the Groc chatbot.
太空公司收购了他的人工智能创业公司 XAI，通过将火箭结合起来，和Groc聊天机器人制造商的卫星公司。

The deal represents one of the most ambitious tie-ups in the technology sector yet, combining a space and defense contractor with a fast-growing AI developer whose costs are largely driven by chips, data centers, and energy.
这笔交易是科技行业迄今为止最雄心勃勃的结合之一，结合一个太空和国防承包商和一个快速增长的人工智能开发商，其成本主要由芯片驱动，数据中心和能源。
This certainly sounds like lots for Musk to be happy about while Tesla experiences declining sales, shrinking market share, and sliding share price.
这对马斯克来说很高兴，而特斯拉的销售量下降，市场份额下降，股价下滑。
Nobody, outside a few diehards in Northern California, are mourning the recent death of the Cybertruck.
在加利福尼亚北部，除了一些徒之外，没有人哀悼最近的网络卡车死亡。
And as the world's attention becomes ever more fixated on artificial intelligence, so does Musk's.
随着世界越来越关注人工智能，马斯克的注意力也越来越集中。
In July, this led to a rebrand of the merged entity which was renamed SpaceX-I, according to iTechPost.
根据iTechPost的说法，在7月，这导致合并的实体重新品牌，
The SpaceX RE-brand places XAI's artificial intelligence operations more directly alongside SpaceX.
太空XRE品牌将XAI的人工智能运营更直接地与太空X.
Future developments are expected to focus on GRC, large-scale computing infrastructure, and further integration between AI systems and SpaceX technology.
预计未来的发展将侧重于GC，大规模计算基础设施以及人工智能系统和SpaceX技术之间的进一步集成。
SpaceX AI now becomes the central identity connecting Musk's artificial intelligence advances with his wider space operations.
太空X人工智能现在成为连接马斯克的人工智能进步与他更广泛的太空运营的核心身份。
October brought another name change to SpaceX superintelligence following Trump's encouragement to stop saying AI.
在特朗普的鼓励停止说人工智能之后，
And who knows what the company will be called if Musk succeeds in his current attempt to merge it with Tesla, though that move appears to face an increasingly thorny regulatory environment.
如果马斯克成功地试图与特斯拉合并，尽管这一举措似乎面临着日益棘手的监管环境。
Despite the almost half a billion dollars Musk fed to Republicans, the blue wave of the midterms has changed the narrative as CNBC reports.
尽管马斯克向共和党人提供了近50亿美元，据CNBC报道，中期的蓝色浪潮改变了讲述。
Deutschabank analysts have noted, we could envision SpaceX facing some incremental headwinds in this type of backdrop.
德国银行分析师指出，我们可以想象SpaceX在这种背景下会面临一些反风。

Governor-elect Inahosa made data centers a major campaign issue, calling for a moratorium until the legislature passes stronger protections on water use, electricity costs, local control, and incentives, and criticizing tax breaks for large facilities.
选任州长Inahosa使数据中心成为竞选的主要问题，呼吁暂停，直到立法机关通过更严格的水使用保护措施，电力成本，地方控制，对于大型设施的税收减免。
Studies. SpaceX and Tesla had lost about $456 billion in market cap by the close of business two days after the election.
太空公司和特斯拉在选举后两天结束业务时损失了4500亿美元的市值。
